tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.description: Gathering information to plan future adversary operations

tactics.name: Resource Development
tactics.description: Establishing resources to support operations (infrastructure, accounts)

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.description: Techniques that use various entry vectors to gain an initial foothold

tactics.name: Execution
tactics.description: Adversary-controlled code running on a local or remote system

tactics.name: Persistence
tactics.description: Techniques used to maintain access across restarts and changed credentials

tactics.name: Privilege Escalation
tactics.description: Gaining higher-level permissions (SYSTEM, root, Domain Admin)

tactics.name: Stealth / Defense Evasion
tactics.description: Techniques used to avoid detection throughout their compromise

tactics.name: Defense Impairment
tactics.description: Disabling, tampering, or degrading security software and logging

tactics.name: Credential Access
tactics.description: Stealing credentials like account names and passwords

tactics.name: Discovery
tactics.description: Observing the system and environment to orient themselves

tactics.name: Lateral Movement
tactics.description: Accessing and controlling remote systems on a network

tactics.name: Collection
tactics.description: Gathering data of interest to the adversary goal

tactics.name: Command and Control
tactics.description: Communicating with systems under adversary control

tactics.name: Exfiltration
tactics.description: Stealing data from the target network

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.description: Manipulating, interrupting, or destroying systems and data

functions.name: Govern
functions.description: Establish and monitor the organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy and policy

functions.name: Identify
functions.description: Understand cybersecurity risks to systems, people, assets, data, and capabilities

functions.name: Protect
functions.description: Implement safeguards to ensure delivery of critical infrastructure services

functions.name: Detect
functions.description: Identify the occurrence of a cybersecurity event in timely manner

functions.name: Respond
functions.description: Take action regarding a detected cybersecurity incident

functions.name: Recover
functions.description: Restore capabilities or services impaired due to a cybersecurity incident

tactics.name: Positioning
tactics.description: Actions taken after access to collect/manipulate data and prepare fraud (synthetic identity, account warming, beneficiary setup, SIM swap, session hijack).

tactics.name: Monetization
tactics.description: Converting stolen assets into usable funds (money mule layering, APP fraud, crypto off-ramping, card cash-out, refund/chargeback abuse).

tactics.name: BEC & Social Engineering
tactics.description: Business Email Compromise, invoice redirection, executive impersonation.

tactics.name: Valid Accounts Abuse
tactics.description: Commercial banking portal takeover, privileged credential stuffing.
